description: Read this agent's saved account-funded job by its returned job ID to check status and recover available result and receipt. Use after submission or when following up on an existing purchase; acceptance is not completion. Report the saved state and only available results, with their limitations. If the job ID was lost, use list_account_jobs with the original idempotency key first. Never authorizes another purchase.

job_id.description: UUID returned for the saved account job. Recover a missing ID with list_account_jobs using the original purchase idempotency key; do not invent an ID or submit again.

name: get_account_job

outputSchema.description: Unmodified Account Core saved-job response. Interpret the saved status before claiming completion; result and receipt availability depends on job state and saved version.

title: Recover an account-funded job
